hooks.logic:
The script register.
The battle settings of the group of the enemy.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let forceAbilityId be the acting enemy's 'constraint' → get-force-ability-id.
  If forceAbilityId, then the enemy uses forceAbilityId.
  Otherwise, the enemy uses the built-in move DO_NOTHING with options {skipStepCnt: false}.
